about: Which fact groups each county the hosted registry serves holds, for what share of its parcels, and which roll years with the value type and files of each. Computed from the registry files by packages/tools/src/fields.ts (scripts/site/gen-fields.ts); a parcel counts for a group when the file holds at least one fact of the group for it. Owners of record are organisations only: natural persons are never stored.

groups.label: building facts (area, year built, floors or units)
